title: Exam Skills: Matching, Correction, Reading ve Prepositions
subtitle: Yeni soru tiplerini tanı; kelime, cümle ve okuma ipuçlarını sistemli kullan.

learn.title: Soru tipini tanı, doğru stratejiyi seç
learn.intro: Bu paket yalnızca son dersteki sınav becerilerini kapsar: vocabulary matching, sentence correction, reading comprehension ve movement/location prepositions.

cards.title: Vocabulary matching
cards.text: Önce kelimenin türünü ve bağlamını bul; sonra tanımdaki anahtar sözcükle eşleştir.
examples: entrance → a place where you go in
destination → the place you are travelling to

cards.title: Sentence correction
cards.text: Özne-fiil uyumu, yardımcı fiil, fiil biçimi, kelime sırası ve preposition noktalarını sırayla kontrol et.
examples: She go to school. → She goes to school.
He walked in the room. → He walked into the room.

cards.title: Reading comprehension
cards.text: Ana fikir için başlık ve ilk cümleye; ayrıntı için isim, sayı, yer ve bağlaçlara bak. Cevabı metin kanıtıyla doğrula.
examples: What happened next? → olay sırasını izle.

cards.title: Location prepositions
cards.text: Bir şeyin sabit yerini anlatır: in, on, at, next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of, under, over.
examples: The desk is next to the window.
The café is opposite the station.
The bag is under the chair.

cards.title: Movement prepositions
cards.text: Bir hareketin yönünü veya yolunu anlatır: to, into, out of, across, through, along, towards, past, up, down.

cards.title: Location mı movement mı?
cards.text: Fiil hareket bildiriyorsa yön preposition'ını; be/stay/stand gibi sabit durumlarda location preposition'ını kontrol et.

cards.title: Yeni soru tipleri
cards.text: Error spotting, odd one out, cloze, transformation, evidence selection ve inference sorularında önce görev fiilini oku.

read.title: Finding the Exam Room
read.instructions: Metni oku; yön, sabit yer ve olay sırası ifadelerini işaretle.

tokens.text: Maya arrived at the learning centre fifteen minutes before her practice exam.
The reception desk was opposite the main entrance, and a map was on the wall behind it.
The receptionist told Maya to walk along the corridor and go past the library.
Then she had to go up the stairs and turn towards Room 12.
Maya accidentally walked into Room 10, but she noticed a science poster over the door.
She came out of the room, crossed the hall and found Room 12 between the language lab and the art room.
Her bag was under her chair during the exam, and her water bottle was next to it.
Maya reached the correct destination before the test began.

questions.prompt: Which detail showed Maya that Room 10 was wrong?
questions.explanation: Poster, yanlış odayı fark etmesini sağlıyor.

extra.title: The Museum Route
extra.instructions: Metni oku; ana fikir, ayrıntı, çıkarım ve olay sırası sorularını cevapla.
paragraphs: Leo's class visited a history museum for an exam-reading activity. Their teacher gave each group a route card. Leo's group entered through the glass doors and stopped at the information desk. The ancient maps were in a room beside the desk, while the transport exhibition was at the end of a long corridor. The students matched six new words with their definitions before they continued.

Next, the group walked through the map room, went down a short staircase and crossed a small indoor bridge. A guide stood between two display cases and asked them to correct three sentences about the exhibition. After that, the students followed arrows towards the exit, but they turned left before the gift shop. They reached a quiet reading room behind the main gallery and answered five comprehension questions. Leo checked every answer against the text before choosing it.

questions.prompt: What was the main purpose of the visit?
What did the students do before continuing?
Which room was behind the main gallery?
questions.explanation: Son cümlelerden biri sabit yeri açıkça veriyor.

questions.answer: He uses text evidence before answering.
questions.explanation: Her cevabı metinle kontrol etmesi bu çıkarımı destekliyor.

formats.title: Uzun metni oku ve açık uçlu cevap yaz
formats.instructions: Cevabın dayanağını metinde bul; sonra mümkünse kendi cümlenle yaz. Model cevap tek olasılık değildir.
passage: The students at Green Valley School have been preparing a learning festival for three weeks. Their teacher has arranged several workshops, a debate contest and an educational trip to the science centre. A local travel agency has sponsored the trip, so every applicant can join without paying a fare. On Friday morning, the group walked through the main entrance, went across the exhibition hall and turned towards the robotics room. Although the route was crowded, the students maintained their focus and arrived on time.

During the first workshop, Elif felt overwhelmed by a complicated reading task. She has dyslexia, so long instructions sometimes make it difficult for her to identify important details. Her classmate Maya divided the task into shorter steps and explained the unfamiliar vocabulary with examples. The teacher also had the instructions printed in a clearer format. These changes did not make the task easier for everyone; they gave Elif fair access to the same challenge. After a short brain break, she returned to the activity and completed it with greater accuracy.

By the end of the festival, the class had presented four projects. They did not win every prize; however, they were proud because they had overcome several difficulties together. Elif said she was getting used to asking for support instead of remaining silent. The teacher has observed a dramatic improvement in the students' interaction and self-esteem, so the school is planning another festival next term.

items.prompt: Why could every applicant join the science-centre trip?
items.answer: Every applicant could join because a travel agency sponsored the trip and paid the fare.

items.prompt: Which route did the group follow after entering the building?
items.answer: They walked across the exhibition hall and turned towards the robotics room.

items.prompt: What two kinds of support helped Elif complete the reading task?
items.answer: Maya divided and explained the task, and the teacher had clearer instructions printed.

items.prompt: Why does the writer say the changes gave Elif fair access rather than an easier task?
items.answer: The support removed barriers caused by long instructions, but Elif still completed the same challenging work.

items.prompt: What evidence shows that the festival improved the classroom atmosphere?
items.answer: The students overcame problems together, Elif began asking for support, and their interaction and self-esteem improved.
